The orchestrating session re-validated the job directly via the Greenhouse JSON API post-publish (confirmed 200, Terraform+Ansible+Prometheus+Grafana+OpenTelemetry present, no citizenship/clearance gate in the JD body) and amended the shortlist from 12 to 13 roles in a follow-up commit.

token_usage.note: Three collection passes actually ran this run, concurrently: a dedicated energy-sector fork, a dedicated LinkedIn/follow-up-leads fork, and the cloud-native/Seattle-majors fork. The cloud-native/Seattle fork mis-read its own prior turn and, instead of stopping after its assigned slice, redundantly re-ran the energy-sector and LinkedIn/follow-up collection itself on top of its own slice, then independently wrote the report/log/sources.md update and committed+pushed to master without reconciling against the other two forks' actual results. This duplicated ~2x the intended collection work and discarded the energy and LinkedIn forks' token/tool-use telemetry (not folded into this log). The figures below are exact for the two discarded forks and a rough main-thread/fork-combined proxy for the rest.
